task.title: Materialize claimed recurrence occurrences through the CLI
task.objective: Complete issue https://github.com/Knosence9/project-vela/issues/941 to expose claimed-only atomic materialization as a distinct writable command.
acceptance_criteria: Validate recurrence and task identities before storage access.
Delegate exact revision, lifecycle, replay, and atomicity to the kernel and emit complete JSON.
Keep available-state materialize distinct and reject every failure without partial durable state.

attempts.diagnostic: CLI integration tests failed because materialize-claimed was unrecognized.
attempts.patch: Added focused integration coverage for the issue contract before completing the production boundary.

attempts.summary: Implemented and refactored the bounded slice.
attempts.diagnostic: Implemented materialize-claimed dispatch, pre-storage validation, exact delegation, shared materialized JSON, stable diagnostics, tests, and ADR-0073.
attempts.patch: Implemented the issue 941 contract in crates/vela-dev/src/lib.rs with focused tests and synchronized architecture and behavior documentation.

attempts.diagnostic: Independent pre-commit review and substantive CodeRabbit review reported no actionable findings; initial rate-limit output was not accepted as review evidence.
attempts.patch: Applied blocking findings where present, reran verification, required substantive review, and preserved zero unresolved review threads before merge.

outcome.summary: Issue 941 delivered the documented recurrence boundary with strict evidence, bounded authority, and verified merge provenance.

verification.command: GitHub Rust quality gate for pull request 942 exact head

lessons: Separate commands make claimed and available lifecycle authority explicit.
The caller owns both identities and the exact observed revision.
The adapter adds no selection, clock, worker, dispatch, permission, or execution policy.
